verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official MCP server that users connect to their coding agent to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage scan issues. A changelog entry extends it to subscription and seat management, and a probe confirms a dedicated MCP server docs page. Missing for 10: setup/auth and tool-list detail in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect cubic's MCP server to your coding agent to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage PR or codebase scan issues.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.cubic.dev/ide/mcp-server
You can now ask your coding agent to check your cubic subscription, manage team seats and roles, and purchase more seats without leaving your MCP client.
